correctness.rationale: The bundled verifier reconstructs the 125-word metric space and independently cross-checks compatibility through radius-one ball disjointness. An exact greedy-color-bounded clique search proves maximum 15; a separate exact enumeration gives 24 maxima through zero. The proof is finite, deterministic, and contains no extrapolation beyond the enumerated domain.
